mentions.name: IMG-PT
mentions.description: A tool that generates ad concepts for products using the information already on the product's website, letting businesses create ads without hiring an agency or spending a large budget.
mentions.problem: Businesses need ads but agencies and large ad budgets are out of reach; the tool generates ads directly from existing website content.
mentions.audience: Product businesses that want ads without an agency or a large budget
mentions.source_excerpt: My brother and i are also building a startup together (https://www.img-pt.com/). Our tool helps generate ads for products just like yours, without needing an agency or a huge budget, using the information on the website you already have.

mentions.name: IMG-PT
mentions.description: AI marketing tool that generates image ads intended to be usable in real campaigns, with cinematic, polished (non-UGC-style) video ad generation shipping soon. It also has an upcoming Meta ads campaign management feature that splits a campaign into ad sets for the funnel, creates the right ads for each, and automatically shifts budget to ads that work while swapping out ones that don't, all within the user's Meta account.
mentions.problem: Existing AI ad-generation tools tend to feel like nice proof-of-concepts that are a bit sloppy and not something you'd actually use in a real-life campaign.
mentions.source_excerpt: For the last year and a half, maybe 2 years, i've been working on a 2-man project with my brother. We're trying to make an AI marketing tool that hopefully isn't complete slop: https://www.img-pt.com/
